title: SignedLinkInvalidatedPayload
description: Payload of the SignedLinkInvalidated event: a signed link stopped being usable before its expiry (INV-REQ-901, FR-AF.23, INV-AC-18216). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4). It carries no passcode, token, e-mail address or mobile number (OWASP ASVS V3).

subjectReference.description: The requestId of masterdata the link was issued for.

reason.description: Why the link was invalidated. Extensible: a consumer treats an unknown value as invalidated (API-41).
